subject: Integration pilot: BedrockBridge runtime plugin + Redwood
messages:
From: Alex Moreno <alex@bedrockbridge.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samira Khan <samira@bedrockbridge.ai>
Date: Sat, 9 May 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Integration pilot: BedrockBridge runtime + Redwood

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for taking a look at this. BedrockBridge builds a lightweight runtime plugin that lets ISVs surface model routing and cost-aware kernel selection inside LangChain and LlamaIndex SDK stacks. We're running a handful of early pilots (one in fintech) and think Redwood's unified serving + routing would be a great fit for a partner pilot: we can drop a plugin into your Dedicated or Private runtime and verify latency/cost improvements for typical chain-heavy workloads.

High-level asks:
- 6-week pilot: integration + joint benchmarks (latency, tokens/op cost, memory pressure)
- Access to a sandbox Dedicated instance or Private test VPC
- A quick security questionnaire so we can provide our SOC2 artifacts

I've attached a draft SOW and the questionnaire. Would you be available for a 30-minute sync next week to sketch the mutual action plan?

Thanks,
Alex
Developer Relations, BedrockBridge
Attachments: bedrockbridge-mvp-sow.pdf (application/pdf), security-questionnaire.xlsx (spreadsheet/xlsx)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Moreno <alex@bedrockbridge.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Integration pilot: BedrockBridge runtime + Redwood

Alex —

Appreciate the write-up. This aligns with a lot of work the Runtime and Partnerships teams have been discussing around SDK-level routing and observability hooks. Quick notes:

- Pilot scope: I suggest a 5-week technical integration and 1-week joint validation run (6 weeks total). We'll focus on 1) LangChain chains that exercise long contexts + streaming, and 2) LlamaIndex retrieval-augmented pipelines with embeddings/nearest-neighbor caches.
- Data/security: we'll need the completed security questionnaire plus SOC2 link before spinning up Dedicated test capacity. Our Security team prefers a VPC peer for Private trials but Dedicated sandbox is also fine.
- Metrics: please include sample prompt sets (target latency P50/P95, token-cost baselines, and typical batch sizes).

Can you send availability for Wed/Thu next week? If you like, Vanessa can run through the commercial and co-sell ideas after we lock the technical plan.

- Karthik
Head of Runtime Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Moreno <alex@bedrockbridge.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Integration pilot: Integration pilot: BedrockBridge runtime + Redwood

Alex —

Great to meet you virtually. A couple of items I can take ownership of:

- I'll share our Partner SOW template (attached) and a short checklist for Dedicated sandbox provisioning so we don't hit administrative delays.
- On co-sell: once the pilot validates the routing & cost benefits, we can create a joint one-pager for our marketplace and run a co-marketing webinar.
- Observability: BedrockBridge should include trace hooks that emit our trace IDs (we can map to Console tracing). If you can add an optional span that annotates kernel selection, that will make regression hunting much easier.

Proposed next steps:
1) Alex sends completed security questionnaire + prompt sets by EOD Thu 5/14
2) Karthik (runtime) & Kim (engineering) triage integration checklist
3) 30-min sync Wed 5/13 11:00 AM PT — propose calendar invite if that works

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Partnerships — Redwood Inference
Attachments: partner-sow-template.pdf (application/pdf)

- For benchmarking, we propose 3 workloads: interactive chat (streaming), retrieval-augmented QA, and multi-step chain-of-thought pipelines that exercise KV cache behavior.

Availability: Wed 5/20 or Thu 5/21 for a 60-minute kickoff with engineering.

Thanks,
Alex
